thread:
maria: kicking off kubeadm bootstrap for eu-west3-GPU-1. goal: kubeadm control-plane HA + 2 gpu nodepools (a100, h100), calico CNI, metallb for control plane LB, and nvidia driver daemonset. starting preflight now. pinging infra owners for network checks. :rocket:
eran: +1. which AZs are we using? want to avoid same rack for all CPs.
sanjay: using eu-west3-a/b/c per the capacity plan. noted cost delta for h100 nodes; added to cost sheet: https://intra.redwood/costs/eu-west3-gpu.
maria: thanks. checklist for this thread: 1) VPC routes/MTU validated 2) calico BGP peering plan 3) metallb address pool reserved 4) KMS key for etcd backups 5) GPU driver daemonset image and tolerations 6) LB healthcheck from cloud provider
li: MTU on the VPC is 1460 by default; calico MTU should be set to 1400 for tcp-offload with nvidia RDMA. confirm before kubeadm init.
maria: noted. running kubeadm with these extraArgs for kube-proxy and kubelet. snippet:```yaml apiVersion: kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta4 kind: ClusterConfiguration networking: podSubnet: 192.168.0.0/16 ``````
devops-bot: deploy-bot: cluster bootstrap job queued (job id: cb-20260401-17). status: preflight.
eran: for calico we should use BGP mesh to avoid IP table churn. will attach BGP ASNs and golang-config to the runbook.
maria: metallb pool reserved: 10.240.100.0/24 (internal-only). Please don't allocate outside this.
sanjay: GPU driver image built: registry.redwood/gpu/driver:v1.12. includes nvidia-container-toolkit and MIG-aware hooks. Daemonset template posted to cluster repo.
maria: running kubeadm init --control-plane-endpoint metallb-eu-west3.internal:6443 --upload-certs --pod-network-cidr=192.168.0.0/16. sharing logs if anything goes sideways.
oncall: oncall: reminder: tag the cluster with heartbeat=enabled so watchman picks it up for SLO alerting.
li: after CPs up, do `kubectl get cs` and `kubectl get nodes -o wide` to verify kubelet versions and taints. Also check calico pods scheduling across AZs.
maria: first control plane came up clean. kube-apiserver logs show TLS cert rotation ok. next CP joining.
eran: watch etcd metrics, verify quorum at >=2/3. if snapshotting fails, check IAM for the S3 backup role.
sanjay: GPU nodepool a100 created via autoscaling group. note: nvidia-driver daemonset failing with OOM on init container. log: `failed to allocate pinned memory` — likely kernel module mismatch.
maria: rollback plan: cordon nodes and apply driver:v1.11 which was stable in staging. also add toleration for node.kubernetes.io/memory-pressure:NoSchedule if init spikes.
li: network test: `iperf3` between pods shows ~9.2Gbps for a100 nodes, expected. h100 nodes haven't joined yet.
maria: h100 nodepool blocked on VPC secondary ranges — cloud team updating subnet allocation. ETA 15m.
eran: quick validation checklist to hand to SRE when ready: - control-plane LB health OK from 3 regions - podCIDR reachable across nodes - BGP mesh established and peering count matches desired - metallb announces controller IPs - kube-proxy mode is ipvs - all daemonsets running (cni, metrics-server, gpu-driver) - admission webhooks healthy - audit logs delivered to S3/KMS
maria: adding that to the runbook and will create a PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-runbooks/pulls/124
oncall: oncall: I added the cluster to the rotation firewall rules and created an alert for node GPU pressure > 90% for 10m.
sanjay: after applying driver:v1.11, daemonset stabilized. h100 pool now able to join (subnet fix applied).
li: final validation before handoff: `kubectl top nodes` shows normal usage, CSI drivers for volumes present, kube-proxy ipvs entries ~ consistent.
maria: ok prepping handoff notes for SRE. will include the kubeadm join tokens (rotated), kubeconfig path, certs backup location, and troubleshooting tips for GPU driver OOM.
eran: suggest adding cost tagging labels on node pools: cost-center:gpu-research and env:prod to enable showback.
maria: done. PR merged. handing off to SRE for ongoing e2e tests and production rollout. :white_check_mark:
li: thanks team. if any post-handoff regressions, @oncall please escalate to infra.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: cluster cb-20260401-17 moved to state HANDOFF. artifacts: s3://redwood-cluster-logs/cb-20260401-17.tar.gz
oncall: oncall: acknowledged. monitoring dashboards linked in runbook.
maria: end of thread — notes and final runbook link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-runbooks/cluster-eu-west3-gpu-1.md.
